explanation_excerpt: PGlite is the durable notebook; Loro is the reconciliation protocol; the graph is the canonical current view.

gaps.description: The exact reconnect queue and resynchronization API remains an implementation decision for task 2; the required observable behavior is frozen here.

transfer_problems: A PGlite reopen test passes while two Loro peers diverge. Can the release gate pass?

A sibling repository passes sync tests while this workspace skips missing dependencies. Can that evidence satisfy the mandatory gate?

grading_method: Source-grounded self-assessment for autonomous execution; no claim of human learner mastery is made.
